payload.core_composition_summary: Sort cities by count, compute phase thresholds, then use two-pointer to populate a sorted set for each query, answering by index.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting to order cities, amortized two-pointer for offline queries, and balanced SortedList for efficient k-th element retrieval.
